_about: Game pieces. Shapes and sizes from the game manuals. Masses and stiffness marked estimated where the manual gives none.

pieces.name: CORAL
pieces.source: 2025 manual: 4 in. Schedule 40 PVC, 11 7/8 in. long. Mass worked out from the pipe's wall and PVC's density (1.4 g/cc)

pieces.name: ALGAE
pieces.source: 2025 manual: 16.25 in. rubber playground ball, inflated to a diameter gauge. The manual gives no pressure: the three pressures and the mass are estimates (owner agreed 2026-11-20)
